name: @yceffort/coldpath
description: Trace which bundled JavaScript executes in real browser scenarios and why it is loaded

scripts.build:js: node -e "fs.rmSync('build', {recursive: true, force: true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: cargo test --locked && pnpm test:browser && pnpm test:corpus && pnpm test:package
scripts.test:corpus: node --run build:js && node scripts/verify-label-score.ts && node scripts/verify-graphs.ts && node scripts/verify-corpus.ts && node scripts/verify-next-prefetch.ts && node scripts/verify-recovery.ts
scripts.test:browser: node --run build:js && node scripts/verify.ts && node scripts/verify-formats.ts && node scripts/verify-collector.ts && node scripts/verify-environment.ts && node scripts/verify-flows.ts && node scripts/verify-treemap.ts && node scripts/verify-comparison.ts && node scripts/verify-inferred.ts && node scripts/verify-profile.ts
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings bin lib scripts benchmarks ui examples/demo && oxfmt --check bin lib scripts benchmarks/*.ts ui examples/demo
scripts.format: oxfmt bin lib scripts benchmarks/*.ts ui examples/demo
